title: End-to-end: reader fetches article propagated from transit to transit
description:
Three-node test: transit A -> transit B -> reader R. Ingest an article on transit A. After propagation to B, verify that a reader connected to B can retrieve the article via ARTICLE <msgid>. Artifact: tests/e2e/full_stack_propagation.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Article reachable via ARTICLE <msgid> on R within 15 seconds of ingestion on A
- Article content is byte-for-byte identical to what was ingested
- Test is deterministic
- Test passes with: cargo test --test full_stack_propagation
